general_web.consequence: No general-web-only evidence used for promotion or rejection.

primary_repository_refreshes.finding: Qwen3.5 vision deletes Qwen3-VL DeepStack helpers and returns pre-merger last_hidden_state plus merged pooler_output; text model uses hybrid recurrent gated-delta and full-attention layers.
Qwen3-VL reference retains deepstack_visual_indexes and deepstack feature injection; this is a material architecture difference from Qwen3.5.
Public libmtmd C API exposes image/audio chunk identity, token positions and final encoded output embeddings; API is explicitly experimental.
mtmd_helper_decode_image_chunk accepts an already-calculated embedding buffer and decodes it into llama_context; normal eval path calls mtmd_encode_chunk then mtmd_get_output_embd then this helper.

Qwen's retrieval embedding models are separately trained and extract a final semantic vector from last-layer EOS hidden state, evidence against assuming raw generative-VLM visual outputs are calibrated retrieval/open-set embeddings.
MobileCLIP2-S0 publishes an 11.4M-parameter image encoder and 1.5 ms image latency on iPhone 12 Pro Max, making it a credible lightweight counterbaseline rather than a strawman heavy second stack.
DINOv3 exposes class and patch tokens and explicitly supports kNN/linear readouts and retrieval with frozen features, making ViT-S/16 a dense-feature adversarial baseline.
